tentang.pim1_bio2: Previously he served as Director of PT Petrotech Penta Nusa (the Energy Infrastructure subholding of PT Rukun Raharja Tbk) and as President Director of PT Artifisial Teknologi Persada (2022–2025). His operational leadership was further honed at PT Elnusa Tbk — including as Operation Director (2021), Vice President of Oilfield Services (2016–2021), and Managing Director of Drilling Oilfield (2014–2016) — after beginning his career as a Wireline Field Engineer at Schlumberger.
tentang.pim1_bio3: He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) and a certification in Strategic Business Management from Prasetiya Mulya Business School.
tentang.pim2_bio2: He began his professional career in 2004 as an Engineer at Perusahaan Gas Negara, and went on to serve as Head of HR Planning & Training Center at PT Timah (Persero) Tbk (2008–2011), Senior HR Manager at PT Lintas Multi Benua (2011–2016), Senior Human Capital Specialist at PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (2016–2018), and HR & OMSS Manager at PT Triguna Internusa Pratama (2018–2023).
tentang.pim2_bio3: Since April 2023 he has served as Director of PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri, bringing more than two decades of leadership experience across the energy, mining, and human capital sectors. In his current role he focuses on leading the company’s business transformation, expanding its portfolio, strengthening competitiveness, and reinforcing the company’s position nationally.
tentang.pace_catatan: PACE represents the shared values of all entities within PT Rukun Raharja Tbk. Each letter stands for one core value, with its own official colour.
tentang.pace1_teks: Pursuing operational excellence so that every job runs effectively and efficiently, delivering high-quality results across the board.
tentang.pace2_teks: Cultivating a growth mindset to adapt to new challenges and accelerate innovation.
tentang.pace3_teks: Understanding customer expectations, delivering value consistently, and building long-term working relationships.
tentang.pace4_teks: Breaking down silos between units so that coordination and collaboration across RAJA Group run smoothly and reinforce one another.
tentang.kepala_teks: Twenty-five years keeping Indonesia’s energy facilities running reliably — from oil and gas to geothermal and power generation.
tentang.kom_bio: Rony Hartanto is a senior executive with more than twenty-five years of experience in the energy, oil and gas, and energy infrastructure sectors. He currently also serves as Director of Engineering and Operations at PT Triguna Internusa Pratama, where he is responsible for developing technical and operational standards for strategic projects and formulating medium- and long-term strategy aligned with the parent company’s business roadmap.
tentang.dir_bio: Fattah Hermana is a professional specializing in organizational development and operations management. With a solid engineering background and a strategic understanding of business, he is known for integrating human capital and operations management to drive company growth and performance. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering from Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) and a Master of Management from PPM School of Management.
tentang.sekilas_p1: PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri (TCM) provides operation, maintenance, and support services for energy sector facilities in Indonesia. Founded on 8 November 2000, TCM is today part of the PT Rukun Raharja Tbk group.
tentang.sekilas_p2: Our scope covers oil and gas facilities, geothermal power plants, and gas terminals and pipeline networks — supported by certified teams and internationally recognised quality, environmental, and occupational safety management systems.
tentang.pil1_teks: Operating since 2000 in the oil, gas, and energy support industry.
tentang.pil2_teks: Based at head office and across all of the company’s operating areas.
tentang.pil3_teks: Zero Accident 2024 and Zero Incident awards from Star Energy Geothermal Salak.
tentang.jalan_lede: Six milestones that shaped TCM into what it is today.
tentang.tl1_teks: PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri was established on 8 November 2000 in Central Jakarta as a support services company for the oil and gas industry.
tentang.tl2_teks: TCM was acquired by PT Triguna Internusa Pratama and became part of the PT Rukun Raharja Tbk group (IDX: RAJA), within the Midstream — Infrastructure & Utilities segment.
tentang.tl3_teks: Began operating and maintaining natural gas distribution facilities at Sei Gelam and Payo Selincah, Jambi Province, together with PT Energasindo Heksa Karya.
tentang.tl4_judul: Expansion into the wider energy sector
tentang.tl4_teks: Extended services to geothermal and power generation facilities, while beginning manpower provision and support facility construction in the Rokan Block, Riau.
tentang.tl5_teks: Entrusted with Operation & Maintenance Support Services for Star Energy Geothermal Salak and Wayang Windu — two major geothermal power plants in West Java.
tentang.tl6_teks: Received the Zero Incident award from Star Energy Geothermal Salak, adding to the Zero Accident Award and Best Contractor recognition earned previously.
tentang.visi_teks: To become a nationally recognised provider of operation, maintenance, and support services for the energy sector.
tentang.misi1: To ensure the reliability of operating and maintenance systems for energy infrastructure facilities.
tentang.misi2: To put quality first through effective and efficient working systems.
tentang.misi3: To prioritise occupational health and safety in every activity.
tentang.pace_lede: Since 2026, TCM has adopted PACE — the shared values of all entities within PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA Group) — as the basis for how we work and serve our customers.
tentang.wil_lede: 256 professional personnel based at head office and across operating areas from Sumatra to East Java.
tentang.cta_teks: We are ready to support the reliable operation and maintenance of your energy facilities, with certified teams and a proven safety record.

proyek.ung1_klien: Star Energy Geothermal Salak, Ltd. & Salak Pratama, Ltd.
proyek.ung1_teks: Full operation and maintenance support for one of the world’s largest geothermal fields. TCM places a multidisciplinary team on site to keep the steam production and power generation facilities reliable throughout the three-year contract.
proyek.ung1_lingkup:
Mechanical, electrical & instrumentation, rotating equipment, and civil
Scaffolding, welding, machining, and heavy equipment & lifting
Material planning & coordination, asset management, SAP and logistics
SHE support: emergency response and daily safety supervision
proyek.ung2_teks: Integrated construction work to prepare the drilling site and connect new wells to the production network — from bare land to a system ready for commissioning.
proyek.ung2_lingkup:
Land clearing, access road construction, and foundation works
Pipe, valve, and equipment installation; welding and insulation
Instrumentation system and electrical cable installation
ITP documentation and as-built drawings through to handover
proyek.ung3_teks: Provision of manpower and a light passenger vehicle fleet, together with construction of support facilities, at Indonesia’s largest oil production block.
proyek.ung3_lingkup:
Provision of operational personnel, including drivers and dispatchers
Provision and maintenance of the light passenger vehicle fleet
Civil works and operation & maintenance support facilities
Field coordination and compliance with OHS standards per specification
proyek.jambi_teks: Since 2009 TCM has operated and maintained the natural gas transmission facilities of PT Energasindo Heksa Karya in Jambi Province — delivering gas to PT PLN (Persero) power plants. Two pipeline sections totalling 47.5 km have been kept reliable without interruption for seventeen years, forming the foundation of TCM’s oil and gas competence.
proyek.jambi_kapsi: Gas metering station operated by TCM in Jambi Province.
proyek.j1_teks: Operation and maintenance of the natural gas transmission line from Tempino Kecil to the PT PLN (Persero) power plant in Payo Selincah. Scope covers gas delivery operations, metering and reporting, routine maintenance of the pipeline and metering facilities, emergency response, and HSE management — TCM’s longest-running contract.
proyek.j2_teks: A continuation of the Payo Selincah line, flowing gas to PT PLN (Persero)’s Sei Gelam power plant. Scope includes operating the gas delivery system, metering and monitoring, maintenance of the pipeline and measurement facilities, provision of manpower and equipment, and daily to monthly operational reporting.

esg.e_butir:
ISO 14001:2015 — Environmental Management System | Covers the full scope of operation, maintenance, and construction work.
Support for geothermal energy | Most of TCM’s work is at geothermal facilities — Gunung Salak, Wayang Windu, and the Cisolok development.
Geothermal Support Business Licences | Construction UPJ1-4/X/2021 and Non-Construction UPJ2-1/XII/2023.
Handling of work-related waste | Follows ISO 14001 environmental management system procedures and client requirements at every work location.
esg.s_butir:
Zero Accident 2024 | Zero workplace accident award.
Zero Incident SEGS 2026 | From Star Energy Geothermal Salak.
SMK3 — Advanced Level category | Ministerial Decree No. 349 of 2025, Minister of Manpower, score 90.96%.
P2-HIV & AIDS Award — Gold, 2024 and 2025 | HIV & AIDS prevention and control programme in the workplace.
Indonesian Red Cross Award 2025 | Blood donation contribution.
CSR Certificate | Social and environmental contribution around our operating areas.
esg.g_butir:
ISO 9001:2015 — Quality Management System | A quality system audited periodically by a certification body.
ISO 45001:2018 — Occupational Health & Safety | The international standard for occupational health and safety.
SKK Migas e-CHSEMS Certificate | Valid until 13 June 2027.
Client CSMS pre-qualifications | Star Energy Geothermal, PLN Indonesia Power, and PT Transportasi Gas Indonesia.
Occupational Health & Safety Committee (P2K3) | P2K3 ratification certificate from the manpower authority.
Complete business legal documents | NIB, IUJK, geothermal support business licences, and NPWP — details are on the Certifications & Awards page.
esg.catatan_awal: Everything on this page is evidenced by certificates and awards that can be checked on the
esg.catatan_akhir: page. TCM has not yet published a sustainability report with measurable indicators; this page sets out practices that are already in place and verified.
esg.kepala_teks: Our commitment to the environment, to the safety and wellbeing of people, and to orderly governance — all of it evidenced by certificates and awards that can be checked.
esg.e_lede: All TCM operation and maintenance work is carried out under a certified environmental management system, and most of it takes place at renewable energy facilities.
esg.s_lede: Worker safety is the first measure of whether our work has succeeded. Beyond that, TCM takes an active part in occupational health and social programmes alongside clients and government.
esg.g_lede: TCM is part of PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (IDX: RAJA), a listed company subject to capital market disclosure rules. TCM’s own working systems are examined regularly through certification and client pre-qualification.

kebijakan.kb1_sub: Kebijakan Mutu, Keselamatan & Kesehatan Kerja, Serta Perlindungan Lingkungan (MK3PL)
kebijakan.kb1_intro: Management and all employees of PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri, as a company providing support services for oil and gas operations, are committed to prioritising quality, occupational health and safety, and environmental protection (QHSE) by:
kebijakan.kb1_daftar:
Complying with regulations and standards relevant to the Company’s business activities.
Integrating quality, occupational health and safety, and environmental protection (QHSE) into every Company activity.
Raising awareness and work competency through training and knowledge sharing.
Applying quality, occupational health and safety, and environmental protection in a “proactive” manner, prioritising the prevention and correction of non-conformances that could lead to workplace accidents, occupational illness, damage to assets, or environmental pollution.
Applying the principles of planning, implementation, correction, and continual improvement.
Establishing and maintaining harmonious relationships with all interested parties.
Ensuring the implementation of QHSE policy and regulations through a balanced reward and punishment mechanism, in accordance with the principles of the QHSE management system.
kebijakan.kb2_intro: With our guiding principle of causing no harm in everything we do, all employees of PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri and its contractors are vested with the authority and responsibility to stop work if it becomes apparent that harm could occur to:
kebijakan.kb2_daftar:
Ourselves as individuals.
Our co-workers.
Assets, whether our own or those of others, including materials and equipment.
The environment in which we work.
The planet as a whole.
Future generations.
kebijakan.kb2_tutup: Should any occasion arise where commencing or continuing a work activity may result in harm to any or all of the above, work must cease immediately and the task be re-evaluated for a safer approach. If there is any doubt about ceasing an activity, the immediate supervisor must be advised and consulted on the best way to continue.
kebijakan.kb3_intro: PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri recognises the risks arising from the effects of drugs and alcohol in the workplace, and has adopted a “Zero Tolerance” policy for unauthorised drugs, narcotics, and alcohol on company premises.
kebijakan.kb3_daftar:
No person is permitted to enter any Company work location while under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or improperly used medication. The Company reserves the right to conduct drug and alcohol testing at any time.
Entry into any work location is conditional upon the Company’s right to search personnel and their belongings for contraband items. Searches are conducted by authorised personnel, in private and as discreetly as possible.
Possession or use of any such contraband item, a positive drug or alcohol test, or refusal to consent to testing or inspection, constitutes grounds for immediate termination of employment.
kebijakan.kb4_intro: While it is recognised that everyone makes a personal choice whether to smoke or not, medical evidence clearly shows that smoking and secondhand smoke can cause irreparable damage to the body. Therefore, in applying our principle of causing no harm, smoking is not permitted in any public area, including any permanent and/or temporary office, accommodation, or hallway:
kebijakan.kb4_daftar:
Common areas such as pantries, toilets, and similar spaces.
Storerooms or warehouses.
First aid rooms.
Workshop, mechanical, or electrical spaces.
Any other area designated by the senior person in charge.
kebijakan.kb4_tutup: Where smoking is permitted, the area must be clearly marked as a designated smoking area. Employees using designated smoking areas are responsible for their general cleanliness and upkeep at all times, and for ensuring that no cigarette butts remain lit, as these may cause a fire.
kebijakan.kb5_judul: HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control in the Workplace Policy
kebijakan.kb5_sub: Kebijakan Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan HIV/AIDS di Tempat Kerja
kebijakan.kb5_intro: PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri is committed to implementing policies for the prevention and control of HIV/AIDS across all work areas and units, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Republic of Indonesia. PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri is committed to:
kebijakan.kb5_daftar:
Conducting outreach on HIV/AIDS prevention and control programmes through education using various media considered effective.
Building employee awareness of the need to protect the dignity of co-workers living with HIV/AIDS.
Treating the health condition of employees living with HIV/AIDS as confidential.
Encouraging employees to undergo routine, confidential, and voluntary HIV/AIDS testing, accompanied by counselling.
Ensuring that this policy is implemented across all work areas and units of PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri.
kebijakan.kb5_tutup: The management of PT Trimitra Cipta Mandiri is responsible for ensuring that this policy is communicated to all employees in all work areas and units so that it is observed and implemented.
kebijakan.kepala_teks: Five official policies in force across all TCM work areas and units, approved and signed by the Director on 3 February 2026 (Revision 2). They apply to all employees and contractors at every work location.
